en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate interior room with neo‑Gothic and Indo‑Moorish arches, chandeliers, decorative cabinets, large vases and a richly carved fireplace. The image occupies the left and central part of the card, while the right side is used for handwritten correspondence. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the room as the Indian Room on the south side of the Monserrate Palace in Cintra, Portugal. There is also a printed serial number and printer information.
